summary_en: North Pacific Bank corrected a numerical error in its dividend forecast announcement dated October 28, 2026. The revision adjusted the earnings per share guidance for fiscal year ending March 2027 from 90.62 yen to 90.61 yen on a consolidated basis and from 91.42 yen to 91.41 yen on a standalone basis, reflecting a rounding correction to per-share net income.
title_en: Notice regarding partial correction of "Notice of Revision of Business Forecast and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)"
translation_en_brief:
On November 5, 2026, North Pacific Bank issued a correction notice regarding its dividend forecast announcement released on October 28, 2026. The company identified a numerical error in the calculation of earnings per share (EPS) and issued a revised forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027.

On a consolidated basis, the revised EPS guidance was adjusted downward from 90.62 yen to 90.61 yen. On a standalone basis, the EPS guidance was similarly adjusted from 91.42 yen to 91.41 yen. These corrections represent rounding adjustments to the per-share net income calculations and do not affect the underlying business forecast or dividend policy. Other forecast metrics, including operating revenues, ordinary profit, and net income attributable to parent company shareholders, remained unchanged from the October 28 announcement.
